asr.full_text: hello hello and welcome to another update video on polygon the polygon chart is obviously moving at the moment it's random pump in my opinion at least from a structural point of view i mean this stuff happens from time to time in crypto uh this doesn't necessarily need to mean we are reversing to the upside it could it could do but without much structure in this advance, there isn't really much to do here. Other than, you know, we can track resistance. The structure of the next pullback should tell us whether this is something more substantial or not. At the moment this move to the downside still looks like a three wave decline. But please note that this chart has lost all its history, right? Because all the historic MADIC charts have been discontinued by exchanges unfortunately. So on TradingView you only have a very incomplete chart and therefore I don't really cover this very often. It is what it is. So, I mean I can really only label this as an ABC down and it's it's a pretty unreliable chart but of course you know if we see breaks of resistance we can start to at some point add support levels because then it means the bulls are leading. This chart has already moved from around about 9.8 cents to 18 cents but But again, these are just green candles. There isn't really much structure. It's a clear three wave move up at the moment. The price broke above the 50% retracement, which is normally quite important for a fourth wave. And we've now reached a 61.8 FIB level, which is also a Fibonacci level relevant for a fourth wave, but already quite a high wave 4. But this can still be treated as a 3-waves move up, right? I will reduce the resistance area a little bit. Only want to show the ones that are really relevant here. Think it's important to recognize that this is a three-wave move up. In this C-wave, it could turn into five, don't get me wrong, it could turn into five waves. And if we get five waves up, well then we can talk about something more bullish potentially. But this is a three-wave move up and the price has reached now ideal targets for a C-wave between $0.17 and and 20.6 cents. But again, until we actually get five waves up, one, two, three, four, five, and then a three wave decline, there isn't really anything bullish. So let's see if we can get five waves up, which means maybe stretch a little higher-higher low, higher high. That gives me clearly 5 waves up. This is not a Buddhist chart. Even though we moved up and the price doubled. And that might sound strange when I say it's not a Buddhist chart, but the trend has not shifted to the upside. It's a 3-wave move up, which is a counter trend move. Price now got to the 61. It's a 3-wave move up, which is a countertrend move. Price now got to the 61.8 Fib level. And if we now start to see any 5-wave decline, then this could be an indication that we've started the 5th wave down. I have to say, of course, you know, this move up looks a little bit more impulsive than a wave 4 should do to the upside. Therefore, I'm open to the idea that something is changing here. It wouldn't be surprising because this chart really gives me a very limited chart history. As I said, all of the context is erased from these charts. And if we talk about ideal targets for the C-Wave decline, and I'm not even sure if that's the right count because there's no history anymore. But then the 100% extension is, of course, an ideal target 5.8 cents that seems far away. It might, it might chop around here a little longer. But for now local trend is up, but the nearest resistance to watch is $0.17, and the move up from the December low is only a three wave move up. That's very important. If I see five waves, I'll of course let you know. But the Polygon chart has been very, very weak, been quite bearish on Polygon for many, many, many, many months actually. failed to hold a higher low I think it was in 2024 at some point um but anyway for a long time it's been bearish beginning of the cycle in 2022 it was looking quite good but that's a long time ago so um yeah let's see I mean key spot here yeah key spot at this golden ratio level and uh so of course if five waves up form then we might have an interesting development. But we should see that in the structure. For now I don't have a clear top confirmed yet. That's the update on Polygon. Hope you liked the update. If you did please hit the like button. Leave a comment and subscribe. And if you're interested in additional updates then check out our X channel for additional charts, updates, news and much more. Hope you enjoyed the update, thanks so much and by the way I'll put the link to our x channel in the comment section. Thanks so much, bye bye.
